Government Warns TV Channels on Programme Code, AI Misuse

India's Ministry of Information and Broadcasting (MIB) has issued a warning to television channels regarding violations of the Programme Code. The ministry cautioned channels against the misuse of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and advised them to use authentic maps of India. Additionally, the MIB cautioned against live coverage of anti-terror operations.
